name: Sling bullets (10)
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 22, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 142
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 22, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 142
Statistics
Cost 1 sp Weight 5 lbs.
Category Ammunition; Proficiency Ammunition
Description
Sling bullets are shaped metal balls, designed to be used by a sling or halfling sling staff. Bullets come in a leather pouch that holds 10 bullets.
